Notes: base unit USD, of the year the publication states.

Notes: US EPA supply chain factors by NAICS.

Notes: The distributed factor and item table.

Label: Factors (generic)
Notes: Any source, reshaped into the Factors columns.  The way in that always works.

Label: USA
Notes: The US EPA supply chain factors are published for United States production and say so in their own limitations.

Label: Column
Notes: Take a source column as it stands.

Label: Constant
Notes: The file does not carry it; the mapping supplies it.

Label: Pivot
Notes: The source puts in rows what the target puts in columns.

Label: Ignore
Notes: Present in the file, not wanted.

Label: Rental
Notes: An expensed service.  Category 1, not capital.

Label: t CO2-e per t
Notes: A thousand times kg CO2-e/t.  Kept apart because the difference is the error nobody sees.

Label: kg CO2-e/m3
Notes: Gaseous fuels are metered in cubic metres and priced against them.

Label: kg/USD
Notes: Denominated in the dollar year the publication states.

Label: kg CO2-e per AUD
Notes: What a spend factor becomes once converted on import.

Label: t CO2-e per $1M AUD
Notes: The capital bands, banded from the EPA factors.

Label: National Greenhouse Accounts
Notes: Published by the Department.  Used as published.

Label: Spend-based, US EPA
Notes: US EPA supply chain factors, and anything derived from them by a published conversion.  Used as published.

Label: Industry publication
Notes: A published factor from an industry body: worldsteel, AusLCI, AGO.  Used as published, whether it is one figure or a hundred.

Label: Our own research
Notes: A figure derived from our own research, standing on no authoritative source.  The only class that may be edited here.
